change_summary: AudioEngineModel::prepare_ir now heap-allocates the IrConvolverV1 candidate via std::make_unique with fail-closed allocation handling instead of materializing a fixed ~256 KB stack local inside a noexcept control-plane transaction.
No ABI/API/schema/DSP-order change; RT audio thread rules untouched; return semantics preserved (allocation failure returns false like every other prepare failure).
motivation: Issue #278 investigation measured hibiki_engine_preview.exe dying with STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW (0xC00000FD) during back-to-back IR prepare + SceneApply transactions; the ~256 KB candidate was one of the largest avoidable per-call stack consumers.
PR #305 mitigated the crash site with a large stack reserve; this slice removes the stack pressure itself so hosts embedding hibiki_hub with default-size stacks stay safe.

coverage: Visual Studio/CMake build of hibiki_hub including modified audio_engine.cpp
distribution self-test sweep and unsigned local verification

first push run 32579013496 failed in the shared handoff gate on a foreign legacy status key (issue #199) that its owner removed minutes later; full local handoff-check passes after that removal

limitations: User-space Windows verification only; no physical audio, WaveRT, HLK or Microsoft signing evidence.
Control-plane transaction path only; RT audio thread behavior is unchanged.
Allocation-failure handling is fail-closed and bounded; no unbounded growth is introduced.
